_doc: Per-dosha diet guidance (classical taste & food associations, phrased as general wellness advice). focus dosha list is combined with seasonal pathya/apathya by the recommendation engine.

favor: Healthy oils and ghee in moderation
Warm spiced milk (if dairy suits you)
avoid: Cold and frozen foods and drinks
Raw salads in excess (especially at night)
breakfast: Warm oats porridge with dates and soaked almonds
Warm spiced milk with a small portion of porridge
dinner: Stewed fruit or warm milk if hungry late
guidance: Eat at regular times; sit down and eat slowly.
Prefer warm over cold, cooked over raw today.

favor: Sweet fruits: melon, pomegranate, grapes, coconut
avoid: Chilli, vinegar and very spicy food
Fermented, sour and salty food in excess
Skipping meals or eating while angry
breakfast: Oats with milk and sweet fruit
lunch: Wheat flatbread with cooling side dishes
dinner: Milk with a pinch of cardamom before bed (if it suits you)
guidance: Do not skip lunch — midday is your strongest meal.

favor: Ginger, black pepper, turmeric; honey in warm water
Light grains: barley, millet, roasted oats
avoid: Heavy dairy (curd, cheese, cream, ice cream)
breakfast: Stewed apple with cinnamon and clove
Warm honey-lemon water with a light bite
lunch: Barley or millet with steamed vegetables
Spiced vegetable stir-fry with light grains
guidance: Favour light, warm, spiced food; make lunch your largest meal.
A brisk walk after meals helps counter heaviness.
